relationships.subject: locus coeruleus
relationships.evidence_quote: Aside from the LC-NE cortical innervation of these regions, rodent models have shown that ascending LC projections to the ACC increase glutamatergic transmission, facilitating contextual, sensory and nociceptive processing

key_findings: Review: the LC-NE system inhibits nociception; chronic pain neuroplasticity reduces LC-NE inhibition and promotes comorbidities.
